title: 第11章 移动炮台第12章 树洞白骨
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
又过了两天，两人决定往回走，根据太阳的位置辨明方向之后，开始向北走。
百万大山据说横跨数十万里，他们去采矿的赤铜矿脉也仅仅进入百万大山千里左右，属于外围区域。秦怀安两人逃跑时候并未注意方向，此时也只能根据大致方位向北方前行。
百万大山中树木茂密，秦怀安和王宝乐手持飞剑，不时砍去挡在身前的灌木。
“秦兄，前面好像有一条河流。”
“走，过去看看。”
接近中午时，两人看到一条河流，河流最宽处也仅仅只有三五丈宽。
“看看能不能抓到鱼，这两天躲在山洞吃辟谷丹嘴里都淡出鸟了。”秦怀安两眼放光的在河边寻找。
穿越过来天天吃辟谷丹，都没正经吃过一顿饭。看到河流想到了前世垂钓的时光。
修仙者果然不是凡人能比拟，秦怀安很快就用木棍削成的标枪插到了好几条肥美的大鱼。
“胖子，找些干柴过来。”
“好嘞！”王宝乐很快就在周边找了很多干柴。
去掉内脏，清洗干净之后，一个火球术引燃木柴，秦怀安架起几条鱼开始烧烤。
香味慢慢的开始弥散开来，王宝乐也蹲在旁边咽着口水。
“秦兄，好手艺，太好吃了。”王宝乐拿着一根木棍，上面串着一条烤好的鱼，大块朵颐。
秦怀安也品尝这异世的第一顿常规意义上的午餐。可能是灵气的滋养，这种鱼比前世的鱼要美味很多，虽然缺少了调味品，但他还是不知不觉吃掉了一条三四斤的大鱼。
吃饱之后，两人找了一个河道稍微窄一点的地方跨越过去。河流的北侧是一座小山，他们跨过去的地方正好是山脚下。
此处颇为平坦，树木也不多，阳光很充足。
这时秦怀安看到不远处有一株灵草，灵草高约半米，灵草叶片细长而柔软，叶缘呈波浪状，其上有七朵含苞欲放的花朵。
玄阳花！竟然是玄阳花！
玄阳花花开七朵，刚刚绽放时采摘药效最佳。

靠着原主积累的药草知识，秦怀安认出这株灵草是玄阳花。
玄阳花和紫阴果是炼制筑基丹的两大主药，价格昂贵，更主要的是极为罕见，很难获得。属于极阳性质的灵药，对生长环境要求较为苛刻。
此处地势是山南水北，算是阳气汇聚之地，所以诞生了这一棵玄阳花。
上百个炼气修士不一定有一人能筑基成功，而筑基丹可以提高筑基成功率，所以是极为珍贵的丹药。玄阳花和紫阴果较难寻找，也是筑基丹珍贵的一个重要原因。
秦怀安快步向前，走到玄阳花旁边，王宝乐也跟了上来。
“秦兄，这是什么？”
“玄阳花，胖子，我们发了。这是炼制筑基丹的主药。”
“筑基丹！秦兄，快采摘下来啊。”
“不急，玄阳花要在完全绽放的时候采摘，那时候采摘药效最佳。现在玄阳花还未完全绽放，看现在的状态，我们估计要等到天黑了。”
就这时，远处一声愤怒的兽吼传来。
“不好！胖子快跑！”秦怀安看到一头妖兽正向这里奔来，此妖兽形似野猪，高约一米五，体型极为庞大，已是一阶后期修为。
content_en:
Two days later, the two decided to go back. After identifying the direction based on the position of the sun, they started walking north.
The Million Mountains are said to span hundreds of thousands of miles, and the red copper veins they mine only go into the Million Mountains for about a thousand miles, so they belong to the peripheral area. Qin Huaian and the other two did not pay attention to the direction when they escaped. At this time, they could only head north based on the general direction.
There are dense trees in the Million Mountains. Qin Huaian and Wang Baole held flying swords and cut down the shrubs in front of them from time to time.
"Brother Qin, there seems to be a river ahead."
"Let's go over and have a look."
Near noon, the two saw a river, which was only three to five feet wide at its widest point.
"Let's see if we can catch fish. I've been hiding in the cave for the past two days and eating Bigu Pill, and the birds have faded out of my mouth." Qin Huaian looked for it by the river with gleaming eyes.
When I traveled back in time, I ate Bigu Pills every day and never had a serious meal. Seeing the river reminded me of the time I spent fishing in my previous life.
As expected, immortal cultivators are not comparable to ordinary people. Qin Huaian quickly used a javelin cut from a wooden stick to plunge into several fat fish.
"Fat man, bring us some dry firewood."
"Okay!" Wang Baole quickly found a lot of dry firewood nearby.
After removing the internal organs and cleaning them, he used a fireball technique to ignite the firewood. Qin Huaian set up a few fish and started grilling them.
The fragrance slowly began to spread, and Wang Baole squatted beside him and swallowed his saliva.
"Brother Qin, your craftsmanship is so good. It's so delicious." Wang Baole held a wooden stick with a grilled fish skewered on it and ate in large pieces.
Qin Huaian also tasted the first regular lunch in this other world. Perhaps due to the nourishment of spiritual energy, this fish was much more delicious than the fish in his previous life. Although it lacked condiments, he still unknowingly ate a big fish weighing three to four kilograms.
After eating, the two found a slightly narrower place to cross the river. There was a hill on the north side of the river, and the place they crossed was right at the foot of the hill.
It is quite flat here, with not many trees and plenty of sunshine.
At this time, Qin Huaian saw a spiritual grass not far away. The spiritual grass was about half a meter high. The leaves of the spiritual grass were slender and soft, with wavy edges. There were seven budding flowers on it.
Xuanyang flower! It turned out to be Xuanyang flower!
Xuanyang flower has seven flowers, and the medicinal effect is best when picked when they have just bloomed.
Relying on the knowledge of medicinal herbs accumulated by the original owner, Qin Huaian recognized this spiritual grass as Xuanyang flower.
Xuanyang flower and Purple Yin fruit are the two main ingredients for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill. They are expensive, and more importantly, extremely rare and difficult to obtain. It is an elixir with extremely positive properties and has strict requirements on the growth environment.
The terrain here is with mountains to the south and water to the north, which is considered a place where Yang Qi gathers, so this Xuanyang flower was born.
Not necessarily one of the hundreds of Qi Refining monks can successfully build the foundation, but the foundation building pill can increase the success rate of foundation building, so it is an extremely precious pill. Xuanyang flower and purple yin fruit are difficult to find, which is also an important reason why the foundation building pill is precious.
Qin Huaian walked forward quickly and walked to Xuanyanghua, and Wang Baole followed.
"Brother Qin, what is this?"
"Xuanyanghua, Fatty, we've sent it. This is the main ingredient for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill."
"Foundation Building Pill! Brother Qin, pick it up quickly."
"There's no rush. The Mysticus flowers should be picked when they are fully blooming. The medicinal effect is best when picked at that time. The Mysticus flowers have not fully bloomed yet. Judging from the current state, we probably have to wait until dark."
At this moment, an angry beast roar came from the distance.
"No! Fatty, run!" Qin Huaian saw a monster running towards here. This monster looked like a wild boar, about one and a half meters tall, and was extremely large. It was already at the late first level of cultivation.
